title: You Slept 8 Hours. Why Are You Still Tired? 😴
caption:
There are 7 kinds of tired. Sleep only fixes 2 of them.

Level 1 is the body battery. Adenosine builds up in your brain all day, and coffee doesn't remove it. It just blocks the signal for a few hours.

Which level of tired are you on right now? 👇
